notes: release 9.4: multi-bank fusion. Tool > BriNeting neural model > multi-bank fusion lets you pick 2 or more installed voices and train a shared fusion model (16616 params vs 8432 base). Fusion voices always use BriNeting neural synthesis, appear in the singer list and can be saved, rendered and deleted. Training reads only the measured .v4voice harmonic spectra, never audio samples. See manual section 31.
